static-dropped-items.name: Static Dropped Items
static-dropped-items.description: Remove the bobbing of items dropped on the ground.

dropped-stack-item-count.name: Dropped Stack Item Count
dropped-stack-item-count.description: The max amount of dropped items to render. This does not scale like vanilla. Set to 0 to disable.

custom-item-scale.name: Custom Item Scale
custom-item-scale.description: Custom scale for any items you list. Set to 0 to disable!

custom-item-scale-list.name: Custom Item Scale List
custom-item-scale-list.description: Use the item selector to add the items you want. Order doesn't matter.
